name: Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B mixed-bit MLX (2-bit experts), text-only

source.format: AMD Quark PTPC FP8: routed expert and attention weights FP8 E4M3 with a float32 per-output-channel scale; pre/post_expert_proj, router, embed, lm_head and norms in bf16/f32
source.upstream: meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B (Meta Muse Spark Open, Muse Model License)

scope: text model only; vision tower, audio tower, vision adapter and projection are NOT included
quantization_format: MLX affine (mx.quantize): per group a bf16 scale and bf16 bias, values packed into uint32; group 128 for routed experts, 64 for everything else

tensor_groups.note: unquantized, cast to float32 (as in the published mlx-community layout)

tensor_naming: identical to the published mlx-community/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-3bit text layout (checked tensor by tensor by finalize.py against that repo's safetensors headers)
dequantization_method: mx.from_fp8 (OCP E4M3, validated against an independent 256-entry table) times the f32 per-output-channel scale, then mx.quantize (bf16 input)

tools.method: each tensor is fetched by HTTP Range straight from the AMD FP8 repo (no temp shards, no BF16/FP8 on disk), dequantized with mx.from_fp8 x per-output-row f32 scale, then mx.quantize on the CPU stream; one part per layer plus shared
tools.finalizer: finalize2.py (checks every tensor name/dtype/shape/bits against the published 3-bit layout, writes index+config, renames parts)

measured_so_far.weight_reconstruction_check: layer 1, expert 5 (gate/up/down) and layer 1 attention q/k/o/gate: FP8 dequant by this code vs the published mlx-community 3-bit weights: relative RMS 0.19-0.21 (a transposed mapping gives 1.42)

equivalence: layer 3 converted twice on the Studio (same file sha256 a91f4878c9a8f816ff3da23c...) and once on the M2 (different file bytes: mlx stores tensors in hash-map order, header 4,671 vs 4,681 B): all 39 per-tensor sha256 equal. Check per tensor, not per file.

result.files: model-00001-of-00063 = shared (embed 4-bit, lm_head 6-bit, final norm); model-(L+2)-of-00063 = layer L
